title: Squaring the cube: a family of octametallic lanthanide complexes including a Dy single-molecule magnet

material_class.structural_family: Ln8 tetrahedron-in-square cage with inner [Ln4O4] cubane

synthesis.procedure: Shared aerobic layered-tube synthesis for 1–8. Solution A: Ln(NO3)3·6H2O (0.3 mmol) in 3.0 mL EtOH and 1.0 mL DMF. Solution B: saoH2 (0.548 g, 4 mmol) and Me4NOH·5H2O (0.724 g, 4 mmol) in 20 mL EtOH. Solution A was divided into three equal portions in 6 mm O.D. Pyrex tubes, carefully layered with solution B, sealed with Teflon tape, and left undisturbed. Block crystals suitable for X-ray collection formed after one week, were collected by filtration, washed with EtOH, and dried in vacuo.

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: block crystals collected by filtration after one week, washed with EtOH, dried in vacuo

properties.summary: Magnetic data were reported for analogues 2–8; compound 1 was structurally characterized but not magnetically discussed.

properties.summary: Zero-field SMM: χMT = 109.74 cm3 K mol−1 at RT, 104.47 at 22 K, then rises to 157.22 at 2 K (ferromagnetic Dy8 core). M(1.8 K, 70 kOe) = 47.37 Nβ. Frequency-dependent ac χ″ at Hdc = 0; Arrhenius ΔE/kB = 6.17 K, τ0 = 3.11×10−5 s; Cole–Cole α ≈ 0.2 (1.8–2.1 K). Under 1 kOe, ΔE/kB = 7.2 K, τ0 = 9.03×10−5 s. Micro-SQUID hysteresis below 1.0 K; resonant QTM step near 0.4 T but none at zero field. DC decay Arrhenius ΔE/kB = 5.1 K in the 0.8–1.5 K range.
